question: How long does standard shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping typically takes 5-7 business days after your order is processed. Processing usually takes 1-2 business days.

question: Do you offer express or expedited shipping?
answer: Yes. Express shipping delivers in 2-3 business days and overnight shipping is available for select zip codes at checkout.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50. Orders under $50 have a flat $5.99 shipping fee. Express rates are calculated at checkout.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking number by email. You can also track your order from the My Orders section of your account.

question: Do you ship to PO boxes or APO addresses?
answer: Yes, we ship to PO boxes and APO/FPO/DPO addresses via standard shipping. Express and overnight options may not be available for these addresses.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for unused items in original packaging. Final sale and personalized items cannot be returned.

question: How do I start a return?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the item you want to return, and click Start Return. Print the prepaid label and drop off the package at any authorized carrier location.

question: When will I receive my refund?
answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect your return. The amount will appear on your original payment method.

question: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it?
answer: Yes. During the return flow, choose Exchange and select your preferred size or color. If the replacement is unavailable, we will issue a refund instead.

question: Who pays for return shipping?
answer: Return shipping is free for defective or incorrect items. For change-of-mind returns, a $6.99 return shipping fee is deducted from your refund unless you have Store Plus membership.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay. We also offer Buy Now Pay Later through Klarna and Afterpay.

question: Is it safe to use my credit card on your website?
answer: Yes. Our checkout is secured with SSL encryption and we are PCI DSS compliant. We never store full credit card numbers on our servers.

question: Can I use multiple gift cards on one order?
answer: You can apply up to two gift cards per order. Any remaining balance can be paid with a credit card, debit card, or PayPal.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Payments may be declined due to insufficient funds, incorrect billing details, or bank security holds. Try another payment method or contact your bank for more information.

question: Do you offer installment or pay-over-time options?
answer: Yes. At checkout, eligible orders can be split into four interest-free payments with Klarna or Afterpay. Approval is subject to provider terms.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel within 30 minutes of placing your order from My Orders. After that, the order may already be processing and cannot be cancelled.

question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
answer: Address changes are possible within 30 minutes of checkout if the order has not shipped. Contact support immediately if you need help updating your address.

question: Can I modify items in my order after checkout?
answer: Item changes are not supported after checkout. Cancel the order within 30 minutes if eligible and place a new order with the correct items.

question: I received the wrong item. What should I do?
answer: We apologize for the error. Start a return for the incorrect item and select Received Wrong Item. We will send a replacement or issue a full refund including shipping.

question: My order arrived damaged. How do I get help?
answer: Report the damage within 7 days through My Orders. Upload photos of the item and packaging and we will arrange a replacement or refund at no cost to you.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up at the top of the page and enter your email and password. You can also create an account during checkout.

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
answer: Click Sign In, then Forgot Password, and enter your email. We will send a secure link to reset your password within a few minutes.

question: How do I update my email or phone number?
answer: Sign in and go to Account Settings. Update your contact details and verify the new email or phone number when prompted.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Account Settings, scroll to Privacy, and select Delete Account. This action is permanent and removes your order history and saved preferences.

question: What is Store Plus membership?
answer: Store Plus is our $9.99/month membership offering free express shipping, free returns, early access to sales, and exclusive member discounts.

question: How do I find my size?
answer: Each product page includes a size guide with measurements. You can also use our Fit Finder tool for personalized size recommendations.

question: Are your products authentic?
answer: Yes. We source directly from authorized brands and distributors. Every item is inspected before shipping and backed by our authenticity guarantee.

question: How do I know if an item is in stock?
answer: In-stock items show Add to Cart on the product page. Out-of-stock items display Notify Me so you can receive an alert when it is available again.

question: Do product prices include tax?
answer: Listed prices do not include tax. Applicable sales tax or VAT is calculated at checkout based on your shipping address.

question: Can I request a product that is out of stock?
answer: Click Notify Me on the product page to join the waitlist. We will email you when the item is back in stock, usually within 2-4 weeks.

question: How do I apply a promo code?
answer: Enter your code in the Promo Code field at checkout and click Apply. Only one promo code can be used per order unless stated otherwise.

question: Why is my coupon code not working?
answer: Coupons may expire, exclude sale items, or require a minimum purchase. Check the offer terms and ensure the code is entered exactly as shown.

question: Do you price match competitors?
answer: We price match identical items from authorized retailers within 14 days of purchase. Submit a price match request with proof of the lower price.

question: How do I use reward points?
answer: Earn 1 point per dollar spent. Redeem 100 points for $5 off at checkout. Points expire 12 months after they are earned if unused.

question: Can I combine multiple discounts on one order?
answer: Only one sitewide promotion or coupon can be applied per order. Reward points and gift cards can be combined with most promotions.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: Reach us via live chat on our website, email support@shopstore.com, or call 1-800-555-0199 Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST.

question: What are your customer service hours?
answer: Phone and live chat support are available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST, and Saturday, 10 AM to 4 PM EST. Email support responds within 24 hours.

question: Do you have a physical store I can visit?
answer: We operate select retail locations in major cities. Use our Store Locator to find hours, directions, and in-store pickup availability.

question: Can I buy a gift card?
answer: Yes. Digital and physical gift cards are available in amounts from $25 to $500. Digital cards are delivered by email within minutes.

question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
answer: Gift wrapping is available at checkout for $4.99 per item. You can include a personalized message printed on a gift note.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: We ship to over 40 countries. International shipping rates and delivery times are shown at checkout based on your destination.

question: Will I have to pay customs or import duties?
answer: International orders may be subject to customs fees, import duties, or taxes charged by your country. These are the responsibility of the recipient.

question: Can I return an international order?
answer: International returns are accepted within 30 days. Return shipping costs are deducted from your refund unless the return is due to our error.

question: How is my personal data protected?
answer: We use industry-standard encryption and follow GDPR and CCPA requirements. Read our Privacy Policy for details on data collection and your rights.

question: How do I unsubscribe from marketing emails?
answer: Click Unsubscribe at the bottom of any marketing email or update your email preferences in Account Settings under Notifications.
